segments.name: Genome editing therapeutics
segments.description: Develops curative therapeutics for patients using a proprietary metagenomics-derived genome editing toolbox.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as one operating and reportable segment, which is the business of developing curative therapeutics for patients using the Company's proprietary, comprehensive metagenomics-derived genome editing toolbox.
